name: SureClaw Voice
description: Serves the browser voice web app and mints OpenAI or xAI browser realtime sessions from the configured realtime voice config.

path.description: Mount path for the voice PWA (default "/voice"). The plugin always serves the bundled assets; serving cannot be disabled.

name.description: Display name shown in the page title, manifest, and the Call button. Default: OpenClaw.

path.description: Default voice engine. Omit or use legacy for existing OpenAI Realtime/xAI behavior; gpt-live uses native OpenClaw Talk with an OpenAI gpt-live-* model.

gptLive.description: Offers the GPT-Live engine alongside the legacy one (the PWA shows a Realtime / GPT-Live switch). Requires OpenClaw 2026.9.4 or newer.

model.description: gpt-live-1 (OpenAI Platform key) or gpt-live-1-codex (ChatGPT OAuth). Omit to let OpenClaw choose from the available credentials.

voice.description: GPT-Live voice. Unknown voices fall back to the model default (marin / cove).
